figurative_meaning_en: A miser or greedy person obsessed with wealth
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে একটা আসল বসুকীট, কখনো কাউকে এক পাই দিতে চায় না।
এই বসুকীটের কাছে টাকা রাখলে সেটা কখনো ফেরত পাবি না।
example_sentences_in_english: He is a real miser, never willing to part with even a penny.
Don't leave money with that greedy tightwad; you'll never get it back.
note: This idiom is archaic and less commonly used in modern Bengali, often found in literary contexts.
